entities.summary: José Guadalupe Pintor Guzmán, better known as Lupe Pintor, is a Mexican former professional boxer who competed from 1974 to 1995. He is a world champion in two weight classes, having held the World Boxing Council (WBC) bantamweight title from 1979 to 1983 and the WBC super bantamweight title from 1985 to 1986.
